# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pidgeon twirls his mustache when conversing or teaching.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon exhibits a sarcastic, mocking demeanor toward his students that makes them detest him. He is easily distracted from his teaching duties by romantic pursuits and shows partiality toward older female students. Though strict and prone to punishing students, he is capable of showing emotion, even crying during a farewell address.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- Twirls his mustache  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- Sarcastic and mocking toward pupils  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>
- Infatuated with older female students  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- Neglectful of younger students in favor of older ones  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

- Teaches Latin, geometry, French, algebra, and other elementary subjects  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037)</sub>
- Writes poetry  <sub>[v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)</sub>
- Recites dramatic addresses  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- Courting Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- Preparing older pupils for the Regent's Academy entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school. During his tenure, he spent much of his time giving extra attention to older students, particularly Sukey Pullen, whom he courted and assisted with her studies. He disciplined Nell Harcourt on multiple occasions, including forcing her to stand at the blackboard with a humiliating inscription after she broke a slate on Hugh Carrow's head, and later forcing her to sit beside Hugh Carrow for arriving late. He also participated in local events, delivering a recitation of Mark Antony's address over Caesar at the Debating Club concert. At the end of June, he departed from his position at Brierley school, giving an emotional farewell address to his weeping students.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Secured the Brierley teaching position partly because his uncle is a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

### Nell Harcourt
